answer: Plant decoys in the grading queue. Each epoch the ledger mixes a few known-good and known-junk answers into every grader's seats, hidden the way a cuckoo egg hides among a sparrow's. A farm whose keys rubber-stamp each other also rubber-stamps the junk, and after a few misses, recorded basalt-permanent on-ledger, its grading weight drops to zero and its attestations stop counting. Seen through that prism, every key must pay for real judgment, which erases the savings of running many.
